question: Select the most appropriate word to fill blank no. 4
solution:
The correct answer is '**An**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence describes a voice heard, and the word before "alien" should be an article.
 
• The appropriate article to use before a word starting with a vowel sound (like "alien") is "an."
 
• "**An**" fits perfectly as the correct article here.
